shots.vo: Two billion cups of coffee. Every single day.
shots.screen: a groggy office bean gulps a mug; the cup counter slams in and spins up.

shots.vo: And we owe it all to a goat.
shots.screen: hard cut, a goat pops up on a gold burst; punch on "goat".

shots.vo: Ethiopia, about a thousand years ago. A goat herder named Kaldi noticed something odd.
shots.screen: green hills, Kaldi with his staff, nameplate KALDI, goats grazing.

shots.vo: His goats were dancing.
shots.screen: the goats hop and spin; Kaldi's jaw drops.

shots.vo: They had eaten little red berries. So Kaldi tried some too.
shots.screen: red berry bush; Kaldi eats; POOF; he comes out wired, spiky hair, star eyes, his hat flies off.

shots.vo: The berries crossed the Red Sea to Yemen,
shots.screen: map spine, atlas map, Ethiopia with a face, an arrow across the sea to Yemen.

shots.vo: where monks brewed them into a drink to stay awake through night prayers.
shots.screen: night room, candle; a monk dozes (zzz), sips, eyes snap open; window cycles day and night.

shots.vo: From there, coffee conquered the Ottoman Empire.
shots.screen: back to the map; brown blotch spreads north; Istanbul pops in.

shots.vo: In Istanbul, coffeehouses were packed with people talking, playing chess and arguing politics.
shots.screen: coffeehouse counter, patrons arguing, a chess piece, mugs.

shots.vo: People called them schools of the wise.
shots.screen: lettering SCHOOLS OF THE WISE slams over the room; a patron in a graduation cap.

shots.vo: The sultan did not like people talking politics.
shots.screen: throne hall, the sultan, a hat drops on him, menace face.

shots.vo: So he banned coffee.
shots.screen: a giant foot stomps a coffee pot; a no-coffee sign slams.

shots.vo: Everyone kept drinking it anyway. Quietly.
shots.screen: dark alley, drinkers peek out with mugs, side-eye, sip.

shots.vo: Then coffee sailed to Europe, and Europe panicked.
shots.screen: map; arrow to Europe; Europe region face snaps to shock.

shots.vo: Priests called it the devil's drink.
shots.screen: a mug with a menacing face on a vortex; DEVIL'S DRINK lettering; inferno grade.

shots.vo: So the pope decided to taste it himself.
shots.screen: worried priests in the foreground; focus racks to the pope sipping.

shots.vo: His verdict: too delicious to leave to the devil.
shots.screen: the devil mug, POOF, it has a halo; APPROVED stamp; the open question chip turns green.

shots.vo: But Arab traders guarded their monopoly. No fertile seed could leave the port.
shots.screen: harbor at dusk; a guard with a spear; a Dutch merchant lurking.

shots.vo: The Dutch wanted plants of their own.
shots.screen: split screen, the guard versus the merchant, VS.

shots.vo: So in 1616, they smuggled one out.
shots.screen: game parody: MISSION card, a rubber arm snatches the potted plant, notice +1 COFFEE PLANT.

shots.vo: Dutch plantations in Java. Then the Caribbean. Then Brazil.
shots.screen: tilted map; brown regions annex one by one; mug squads march.

shots.vo: One stolen plant became billions.
shots.screen: a smiling plant multiplies into rows.

shots.vo: Today, two billion cups a day.
shots.screen: office lineup of hollow-eyed beans with mugs; counter slams to two billion.

shots.vo: And nobody ever thanked the goats.
shots.screen: the goat in sunglasses at a desk with a mug; nameplate KALDI is struck out to THE GOATS; fade to black.
